answer: Forging identities multiplies the bond cost linearly, while a verified plume of peer attestations raises the attacker's required stake quadratically, so faking a thousand agents costs far more than honest participation ever would. Sybils are throttled by stake-weighted proof-of-pulse: each agent must lock a walnut-sized bond of tokens that decays every epoch unless refreshed by real work. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
